scripts.build: bun --no-env-file run clean && bun --no-env-file build src/cli.ts --target bun --outdir dist && bun --no-env-file -e "import {chmodSync} from 'node:fs';chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755);"
scripts.test:e2e: bun --no-env-file test ./tests/cli.test.ts tests/task-cli.test.ts tests/room-cli.test.ts tests/event-cli.test.ts tests/daemon-cli.test.ts tests/daemon-server.test.ts tests/cli-client.test.ts tests/session-runtime.test.ts tests/session-cli.test.ts tests/daemon-long-command.test.ts tests/memory-cli.test.ts tests/daemon-database.test.ts tests/task-recovery-cli.test.ts tests/task-review-cli.test.ts tests/agent-reporting-cli.test.ts tests/a2a-cli.test.ts tests/activation-cli.test.ts tests/room-wake-up-cli.test.ts
scripts.check: bun --no-env-file run check:static && bun --no-env-file test ./tests && bun --no-env-file run review:plan
scripts.format:check: bun --no-env-file node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format: bun --no-env-file node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --write src tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.review:plan: bun --no-env-file node_modules/jev-lint/dist/cli.js check src tests scripts --dry-run --json
scripts.check:static: bun --no-env-file run typecheck && bun --no-env-file run lint && bun --no-env-file run format:check && bun --no-env-file run lint:ast
scripts.verify:head: bun --no-env-file scripts/local-gate.ts head
